title: Ansel and the Witness
author: P. M. Montrose
blurb: Noor Vane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
